Two Indian Films Achieve Significant Box Office Milestones

The devotional film 'Hanuman Ansh' has achieved a box office collection of over ₹122 crore net in India against a reported ₹2 crore budget, with its 31st-day collection reportedly exceeding ₹22.75 crore. Simultaneously, the crime thriller 'Mirzapur The Movie' has grossed over ₹132 crore worldwide, with its third-day collection reportedly nearing ₹100 crore in India. Actor Varun Dhawan recommended 'Hanuman Ansh' after watching it with his mother, describing the experience as 'amazing' and 'purely made'. Filmmaker Anubhav Sinha commented that the success of films like 'Mirzapur' and 'Hanuman Ansh' should be watched carefully by Bollywood.
